name: opencode-worker
description: Codex delegates bounded tasks to local OpenCode with profile-driven OMO models and controlled child agents.

interface.shortDescription: Use your OpenCode Go subscription for bounded worker tasks.
interface.longDescription: Run, inspect, continue and cancel local OpenCode worker sessions from Codex. No web management page. Codex retains judgment and acceptance.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use OpenCode Worker to handle a bounded task and return the result for review.
